Divinity: Original Sin Tabletop Campaign Community Data

milestones.title: The Merryweather Shore
milestones.description: Wash ashore upon the shores of Fort Joy following the shipwreck, gather companions, and slip past Magister patrols.

milestones.title: Shattering the Source Collar
milestones.description: Infiltrate the prison bastion, liberate your latent Source power, and break through the fortress perimeter into the wild.

milestones.title: Sanctuary in the Marshes
milestones.description: Traverse dangerous toxic bogs and uncover forgotten Source shrines and ancient ruins harboring seekers.

milestones.title: Incursion of the Voidwoken
milestones.description: Hold the defensive line against monstrous Void beasts pouring through planar tears and master advanced elemental combos.

milestones.title: Ascension in the Hall of Echoes
milestones.description: Enter the ancestral Hall of Echoes, overcome the ultimate trial, and claim your place as the new Divine of Rivellon.
